Use case: ui-mockup. Asset: one polished IN-GAME RACE screenshot concept for Project Run, a portrait H5 Ragnarok-IP monster-mounted spectator racing game. Output ONE image only, portrait 9:16 aspect ratio (720x1280 design grid), no device frame, no collage, no title board. Art must fill the frame edge-to-edge.
Reference inputs: original project female and male swordsman character renders, Peco Peco mount, giant Poring mount. Use as identity references, not as paste-in cutouts. Female: long blue-gray hair, brown cap with gold cross-shaped badge and silver ear plates, silver shoulder armor, blue skirt/tunic, brown belt and boots. Male: tousled blond hair, silver pauldrons, blue scarf/tunic, brown leather and silver shin armor. Fix the placeholder/malformed faces into attractive expressive anime faces. Peco Peco: yellow feathered round-bodied bird, orange-red crest and tail, dark curved black beak with red band, brown leather tack, powerful scaled feet. Giant Poring: round pink jelly monster with tiny dark eyes, curved smile and stitched brown saddle harness. EVERY visible racer is physically riding a monster, thighs straddling saddle, hands on reins, plausible rider/mount proportions, no riders running on foot.
Visual hierarchy: roughly top 13% for compact progression HUD, central 64-68% racing scene, bottom 18-22% current-runner status and spectator controls. Safe-area-aware padding. Show meaningful movement, opponents at different depths, full selected rider and mount without cropping feet or heads. The character rendering must be appealing enough to judge art direction, not generic placeholders.
HUD: exact short text "PROJECT RUN", "START", "GOAL", "남은 거리 420m", small numbered race markers, one subtle auto-skill toast "자동 발동", single selected rider panel labelled "내 주자" and large "2위", short commentary "선두를 향해!", bottom controls "카메라", "×1", "건너뛰기", "메뉴". Clear readable Korean type, avoid additional prose. This is a visual mockup; use one focused-rider card without implying a finalized team size. No joystick, combat buttons, manual skill buttons, lobby menus, result screens, giant advertising slogans, watermark, horse-girl racers or unrelated IP character designs.
Rendering technique: EVERY in-world element is hand-drawn 2D: riders, monster mounts, grass, architecture, clouds, railings and shadows. Elegant polished anime illustrations / game sprites against carefully painted 2D backgrounds. Clear ink contours, beautiful lively faces, sophisticated shape design. NO rendered 3D objects and NO photography. Redraw supplied low-poly assets as appealing new high-quality 2D art while preserving costume and monster identity.
